verdict.rationale: Ardent branches are isolated copies of your actual production Postgres from Supabase, RDS, PlanetScale, or self-hosted sources, described as an exact copy of production. That implies genuine Postgres behaviour rather than a lookalike subset. However, only Postgres is supported, and the docs never address extension or version parity on branches. missing for 10: documented extension support/parity on branches, Postgres version compatibility details, MySQL or SQLite engine support, independent hands-on corroboration of dialect fidelity.

support.subject: As a developer, I get real engine compatibility — the Postgres, MySQL, or SQLite dialect and extensions my existing code expects — not a lookalike subset

citations.quote: Ardent creates instant, isolated copies of your production Postgres database
Any Postgres — Supabase, RDS, PlanetScale, or self-hosted.
run your full test suite, including destructive operations, against an exact copy of production.
